page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfr7.24xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 96 dedicated physical cores and 96 vCPUs, utilizing the Intel Xeon 8369HB processor operating at a clock speed of 3.3 GHz. The system is configured with a 1.0 thread-per-core ratio, ensuring dedicated physical execution resources for each virtual processor.

This instance is equipped with 768.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of 8.0 GB of RAM per core. It does not include any local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met through network-attached block storage. The instance also lacks hardware GPU accelerators, focusing its resource profile entirely on CPU and memory capacity.

Networking capabilities include a baseline bandwidth of 32 Gbps. Given the 1:8 vCPU-to-RAM ratio and the dedicated core allocation, this instance is designed for memory-intensive workloads. Appropriate use cases include large-scale in-memory databases, enterprise resource planning systems, heavy data processing pipelines, and memory-bound analytical workloads that do not require local NVMe storage or GPU acceleration.
